description:
Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead)

**AI-Enabled Security Operations | 24/7 SOC**

**Location: Remote – Pune/Baroda, India**

**Department: IT Cybersecurity – Security Operations Center (SOC)**

**Reports To: SOC Manager**

**Work Schedule:** 24/7 rotational shifts

**About the Role**
==================

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead) to lead day-to-day SOC operations, oversee security investigations, coordinate incident response, and mentor SOC analysts. The ideal candidate will bring strong SIEM/EDR expertise, advanced threat investigation skills, and hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools and automation to improve SOC efficiency and detection capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead SOC shift operations, prioritize alerts, manage escalations, and ensure timely handovers and SLA adherence.

* Investigate complex incidents involving phishing, malware, ransomware, compromised accounts, endpoint threats, and suspicious network activity.

* Conduct threat hunting, correlate security telemetry, and map attacker behavior to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

* Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot SIEM queries, analytics rules, and detection use cases using Microsoft Sentinel and KQL.

* Use approved AI/LLM tools for alert triage, investigation assistance, threat intelligence enrichment, KQL development, incident reporting, and workflow automation; independently validate AI-generated outputs.

* Automate repetitive SOC tasks using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR capabilities.

* Mentor analysts, improve investigation quality, reduce false positives, and maintain accurate incident documentation and audit-ready evidence.

* Coordinate with Incident Response, IT, Endpoint, Network, and Cloud teams to support containment, remediation, and recovery.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
======================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

* 5+ years of experience in SOC, cyber defense, or incident response, including shift leadership, incident coordination, or analyst mentoring.

* Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, incident investigation, and threat detection.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Sentinel and KQL; experience with Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, or similar security platforms.

* Strong understanding of networking, Windows/Linux, identity security, email threats, and MITRE ATT&CK.

* Mandatory practical AI/LLM proficiency, including prompt engineering, AI-assisted investigations, validation of AI-generated queries/scripts, and awareness of hallucinations, prompt injection, and data privacy risks.

* Scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR tools.

* Strong analytical, communication, decision-making, and team leadership skills; willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, GCIH, or relevant SIEM/EDR vendor certifications.

* Experience in proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, cloud security, and SOC process improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Effective shift leadership and timely, high-quality incident handling.

* Improved detection coverage, investigation efficiency, and reduced false positives.

* Practical adoption of AI and automation to reduce repetitive work while maintaining security, accuracy, and human oversight.

* Strong analyst development, documentation, and operational consistency.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital S/W Engineer Sr Analyst Shape, build, and govern high-impact API solutions as a Senior Systems Engineer, sitting at the intersection of hands-on Apigee development and API design leadership within Citi's Digital Engineering organization. In this hybrid technical role, you will both develop and configure production API solutions on Google Apigee and lead the design and specification of API interfaces and integration patterns — owning mid-size features end-to-end from architecture through deployment, while contributing to larger platform initiatives.

  
  

You will be equally comfortable configuring Apigee proxies and policies as you are producing API design artefacts, leading design reviews, and governing integration standards. This role sits within Citi's Wealth Digital engineering team, where your contributions will directly shape API quality, security posture, and delivery outcomes at scale.

  
  

Responsibilities

  
  

Apigee

* Design and configure API proxies on Google Apigee, including proxy configurations, flow definitions, route rules, and target endpoint setup.

* Define and maintain Apigee policies — including traffic management (quota, spike arrest, rate limiting), mediation (JSON-to-XML, message transformation), and security (OAuth, API key validation, JWT verification) policies.

* Implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) authorization flows natively within Apigee, including authorization code, client credentials, and token introspection patterns.

* Configure and manage Apigee environments, API products, developer portals, and monetization configurations in line with platform governance standards.

* Integrate Apigee with backend services, identity providers, and downstream systems through secure, performant target configurations.

  
  

API Design & Governance

* Lead the design and specification of RESTful APIs, producing OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, API contracts, and integration specifications that engineering teams implement against.

* Apply Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles in both API design specifications and Apigee proxy configurations to protect sensitive financial data exchanges.

* Apply knowledge of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CDR, Section 1033) to design and build compliant, interoperable API interfaces on the Apigee platform.

* Define and enforce API design standards and governance guidelines, governing APIGEE Products and Proxies ,including naming conventions, versioning strategies, error response schemas, and pagination patterns.

* Facilitate and lead API design reviews and architecture walkthroughs, providing well-reasoned recommendations that guide engineering implementation decisions.

* Produce technical diagrams — sequence diagrams, flow diagrams, and system context maps — to document API behavior, data flows, Apigee policy execution, and integration touchpoints.

  
  

Leadership & Collaboration

* Communicate technical progress and risks proactively across engineering and product teams, managing competing priorities and keeping stakeholders aligned.

* Review delivery and API quality metrics regularly, identifying opportunities to improve development workflows, proxy performance, and governance processes.

* Mentor and upskill junior engineers through code reviews, proxy design walkthroughs, and structured knowledge-sharing sessions.

* Evaluate technical and business risk in design and implementation decisions, escalating issues with transparency to protect Citi and its clients.

  
  

Required Qualifications & Skills

* 8–10 years of experience in a product development, engineering, or technology product management environment, including 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and configuring APIs on Google Apigee (proxies, flow configurations, policy chaining, shared flows, and target endpoints).

* Advanced expertise in RESTful API design & architecture, OpenAPI 3.x specification authoring, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Deep knowledge of API security & identity standards, including OAuth 2.0 (OAuthV2 policies, Client Credentials), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles across API contracts and Apigee configurations.

* Strong understanding of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CFPB Section 1033) and global data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) to ensure compliant, interoperable interface design.

* Skilled in vendor and partner management, effectively collaborating with third-party service providers to evaluate tools and drive solution delivery.

* Hands-on delivery in Agile environments, applying Scrum/Kanban practices to lead cross-functional sprint teams from concept through deployment.

* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with a data-driven, results-oriented approach to resolving complex system challenges and optimizing delivery metrics.

* Working familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Devin.AI) and prompt engineering methodologies to improve design velocity and documentation quality.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven capability to influence both senior technical and business stakeholders, articulate technical trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design walkthroughs.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Fonazo is hiring a Cybersecurity Engineer to own the security of a real-time, multi-tenant voice AI product used by enterprises in regulated industries.

Fonazo is an AI Voice Agent Builder. A business launches a multilingual voice agent in about two minutes. Each agent has its own phone number, speaks 76 languages, sends WhatsApp and SMS, connects to customer CRM and calendar systems, and records and analyses every call. The customers are banks, insurers, hospitals, logistics firms, and government bodies across India, the UAE, the US, the UK, and Europe.

That creates a security surface few products have: live voice, telephony, language models, customer integrations, call recordings, and personal data, all inside a sub-second response budget. This role secures every layer of it and gives enterprise security teams the evidence to approve Fonazo quickly.

**Reports to** - Founder and CEO

**Base** - Pune, India

**Type** - Full time

**Experience** - 4+ years in security engineering for cloud-native, multi-tenant products

**What the role owns**

* Security architecture across the product: identity and access, network segmentation, secrets, encryption in transit and at rest, and key management.
* Tenant isolation. One customer's agents, recordings, transcripts, contacts, and analytics are never reachable from another's, and that is proven by test.
* AI and agent security: prompt injection, data leakage through agent responses, tool and integration abuse, voice spoofing, and misuse of agents for fraud or social engineering.
* Telephony and messaging security: toll fraud, number abuse, signalling attacks, and account takeover of calling resources.
* Protection of call recordings and personal data: redaction, access logging, retention enforcement, and secure deletion.
* Integration security for customer CRM, calendar, and messaging connections: token handling, scope minimisation, and webhook validation.
* Secure development lifecycle: threat modelling, code review, dependency and container scanning, and security gates in the release pipeline.
* Detection and response: logging, alerting, incident runbooks, on-call, and post-incident reviews.
* Offensive testing: internal penetration tests, management of external testers, and a responsible disclosure programme.
* The technical controls and evidence behind independent audits such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, in partnership with the Compliance Engineer.
* Enterprise security reviews: architecture walkthroughs and questionnaire responses that get Fonazo approved by bank and hospital security teams.

**What the candidate brings**

* 4+ years securing cloud-native, multi-tenant software in production.
* Depth in cloud security, container and orchestration security, and identity and access management.
* Application security experience: threat modelling, secure code review, and API security.
* Practical incident response experience, including at least one real incident led from detection to closure.
* Offensive skills sufficient to test the product personally and to judge external findings.
* Working knowledge of language model security risks, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* The judgement to add security without adding latency to a live voice call.
* Experience with real-time communications or telephony security is a strong advantage.
* Experience in BFSI, healthcare, or another regulated sector is an advantage.
* Recognised certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, or cloud security specialisations are welcome and not required.

**Stack and tooling**

* Fonazo does not publish its internal architecture. Fit is assessed on what the candidate has secured in production, so every application should state:
* Cloud providers and services secured, and at what scale.
* Container, orchestration, and infrastructure as code tooling worked with.
* Detection, logging, and response tooling operated, and which detections were written personally.
* Scanning and testing tools used across code, dependencies, containers, and running systems.
* Secrets management, key management, and identity systems deployed.
* Languages used for security tooling and automation.
* Real-time voice, telephony, or messaging systems secured, if any.
* AI or language model systems secured, the threats found, and the mitigations shipped.
* The security stack the candidate would choose for a real-time, multi-tenant voice AI product from zero, and why.

**What success looks like**

Timeframe - Outcome

30 days - Full threat model of the product and a ranked remediation plan agreed with engineering

90 days - Security gates live in the release pipeline, tenant isolation tests automated, and incident runbooks rehearsed

180 days - External penetration test completed with all critical and high findings closed, and a responsible disclosure programme open

12 months - Enterprise security reviews cleared from a standard evidence pack, with independent audit controls operating continuously

**Why this role**

* A security surface that combines voice, telephony, language models, and enterprise data in real time.
* First dedicated security hire, with the authority to set the architecture and the standard.
* Security that closes deals: the work is presented directly to enterprise security teams.

Describe the role:

The VRMP Analyst will be responsible for executing goals related to process enhancement and vendor inventory enrichment projects primarily through day\-to\-day support tasks. These tasks will include managing vendor data and inventory and supporting the annual vendor due diligence questionnaire exercise. This role would include configuring ProcessUnity, sending the questionnaires, and tracking responses. The candidate will also look for opportunities to improve our operational processes.

AB has a long history of adhering to and promoting strong professional ethics and is committed to conducting our business according to the highest standards of honesty and fairness.
